description: Combine several shopping or ingredient lists into one, summing the same item across lists (volumes and weights converted to a friendly unit) and noting which list each came from. Use when shopping for several recipes or meals at once. Do NOT use to resize one recipe (use scale_recipe) or price it (use cost_per_serving).

lists.description: Shopping lists to merge (at least one item overall), e.g. [{"name":"Pancakes","items":[{"item":"milk","quantity":1,"unit":"cup"}]}]

quantity.description: Amount, non-negative; omit for non-numeric items (listed in skipped_no_quantity)

unit.description: Unit such as cup, tbsp, g, kg, or a free label like 'can'; omit for plain counts

name.description: List label shown in from_lists, e.g. 'Saturday dinner'; default 'list N'

name: merge_shopping_list

merged.description: One line per item and unit kind, with summed quantities

from_lists.description: Names of the lists this item came from

unit.description: Display unit, e.g. 'cup', 'g', 'each' or a free label

note.description: Summary of the merge and its limits

skipped_no_quantity.description: Items given without a quantity, kept as notes

title: Merge shopping list
